notes: Jetsnack, the custom-design-system sample (JetsnackTheme over its own colour system). :app declares 23 @Preview functions, all catalogued, including the Glance widget's ImageTextListLayoutPreview, whose Small/Medium/LargeWidgetPreview multipreviews are declared in the same module. Two previews are excluded, and their catalog entries go with them since no permutation survives: HomePreview (Feed.kt) and CartPreview (Cart.kt) both throw IllegalStateException: No shared element scope — Feed's DestinationBar and Cart read LocalSharedTransitionScope, which only JetsnackApp's SharedTransitionLayout provides and neither preview installs, so they fail standalone in every host, Android Studio included. The feed is still shown through the JetsnackApp app-shell preview. 53 of 59 renders (21 functions catalogued of 23). Built from UNMODIFIED upstream android/compose-samples (main), replacing the catalog preview.coo.ee served from the yschimke/compose-samples fork: that fork's `previews` branch carried roughly ten thousand lines of catalog-only preview sources that no longer apply to upstream, and none of them is carried over — this import renders upstream's own @Preview functions only, and every spec entry names one. The Theme control comes from the sample's own theme composable via `themes` in the spec, replacing the fork's re-themed Material 3 tab. Each sample is its own Gradle build in a subdirectory of the repository, hence workingDirectory. Licence: Apache-2.0.
